text:
rachel: Quick thread  We need a firm policy for quota rebalancing when a tenant requests temporary inspect credits during a rollout. Legal wants clarity on PII capture guarantees.

tom: TL;DR: never steal credits silently from other tenants. Options: 1) temporary credit loan from a shared pool, 2) owner-approved transfer from the same tenant's reserved bucket, 3) ephemeral trial credits against billing.

priya: Shared pool seems easiest for ops but legal hates cross-tenant pools. Can we do a shared pool that only issues metadata or very-low-sensitivity captures by default? Full payload still needs per-tenant approval.

samir: Agreed. Proposal: shared pool = metadata-only credits (low weight). For payload captures use per-tenant `inspect_credits`. When tenant asks for temporary bump, UI offers: "Borrow low-sensitivity credits" (fast) or "Request owner approval for payload" (slower).

rachel: UX: console should show exact origin of credits: `owned`, `borrowed(shared)`, `one-off(billing)`. Borrowed must have an expiry and visible provenance.

tom: Implementation note: credit token has fields `source:owned|shared|billing`, `weight:int`, `expiry_ts`, `approval_id` (if any). We only store token metadata, not raw payloads.

priya: Security: still no raw ids in logs. Use HMAC per-tenant salt + `salt_id` in envelope. Developers see pseudo_ids only. Any export of raw payload must be SRE-mediated with an audit entry.

samir: Rate limits: borrowing flow limited to 2 borrow ops/min per-tenant, shared pool size is an ops-config value. When shared pool < 10% emit company-wide alert.

infra-bot: FYI scheduled test: shared-pool canary for two tenants on 2024-10-05 02:00 UTC. Monitor `shared_pool_available` metric.

rachel: We also need fairness across routes. High-churn chat routes should not starve low-volume admin routes when borrowing enabled. Suggest per-route caps on borrowed credits and a decay window.

tom: Good catch. Per-route cap impl: route config declares `borrow_cap_pct` (default 20%). When tenant borrows, system enforces both tenant-level and route-level caps.

priya: Envelope sketch for captured event (metadata-first):
```json
{"env":"inspect.v2","tenant":"t-xyz","source":"borrowed(shared)","approval_id":"", "fingerprint":"hmac-v1:ee33...","salt_id":"s-2024q3","sensitivity":"medium","summary":"truncated resp"}
```

samir: Retention and TTL: borrowed-capture payloads TTL=14d, owned-capture TTL=30d. Billing one-offs keep TTL per billing contract. Auto-delete unless `legal_hold=true`.

rachel: Legal ask: require justification field on borrow request (free text) that attaches to the audit entry and is searchable. Also require owner notification when borrowed credits used for payload capture.

tom: Ops runbook: if shared pool is exhausted, auto-fallback to metadata-only captures + notify owners. Provide one-click request to convert to billing one-off (if tenant has billing configured).

priya: Edgecases: cross-tenant correlation: even with HMAC, we should avoid storing combined hashed traces that could be used to link users across tenants. Ensure we do not log multi-tenant join keys.

samir: Implementation: any cross-tenant telemetry (metrics aggregation) must strip HMACs or use differential counts, not fingerprints. Fingerprints stay in tenant-scoped storage only.

rachel: Action items: 1) samir -> design credit token schema + enforcement code. 2) tom -> console wireframes showing credit provenance and one-click request flows. 3) priya -> security/legal checklist + HMAC RFC. Put behind `feature:inspect_credit_borrow_v1`.

infra-bot: NOTE: RFC watcher added. Please ping compliance/security reviews.

tom: I'll mock a short RFC and post link here later today.

priya: Also add metric `borrowed_credit_burn_by_route` for visibility.

samir: Will add metric + dashboard tile to ops deck.

rachel: Great. thanks all. short RFC + canary plan next steps.
